title: When to confirm final guest numbers for catering
body_html:
The final guest number is the one figure that moves everything else in a catered party: food counts, staffing, table plan and the invoice. Invite a hundred, confirm ninety and the food maths shrink by ten mouths; confirm a hundred and twenty on the day and the kitchen cannot buy its way out. Catering starts from AED 90 per person for food only, so an accurate count is what keeps the quote honest — see the catering service in Dubai page for menus, and use the timeline below to set your confirmation date.

What the final count changes

Confirmed changeWhat it movesHow late it still works
Food quantitiesPer-person portions and platter countsUsually a few days before, at shopping
StaffingNumber of servers and chefs on siteEarlier — rosters are built around the count
RentalsTables, chairs, glassware, linensEarliest — rental stock is finite
Table planSeating layout and service flowDays before, after rentals are set

A confirmation timeline (hypothetical)

Wedding-size and party-size events run the same shape. Send invitations six weeks out. Set your RSVP deadline five days before the event and state it on the invitation. Chase non-repliers for two days, then freeze the count three days out — that is the number the caterer shops, staffs and prices against. Keep a small buffer: food is planned with a modest overage per table rather than an open-ended margin, so late extras need a conversation, not a silent stretch.

When numbers change late

  • Counts going up: call the caterer the same day; a few extra plates usually work, a doubling does not.
  • Counts going down: confirm whether per-person pricing adjusts or the quoted minimum holds.
  • No-shows on the day: the confirmed count stands — the food was already bought and staffed.
  • Two hosts giving different numbers: nominate one person to own the count, or the caterer plans to the wrong one.

Next step: send your invitation-list size, event date and venue through the catering page and the confirmation timeline above becomes your booking plan. Related reading: how many guests a Dubai caterer can serve and comparing catering quotes in Dubai.
